sentences.text: Shri S S Kushwaha- Counsel for State.
By order dated 1-12-2025, it was made clear that the record of Case No. 50/2020/Food Safety has not been received.
Even till today, the same has not been received.
Accordingly, Additional District Magistrate/Adjudicating Officer, Morena is directed to submit his personal explanation as to why the record of the said case is not being sent.

Office is directed to send a reminder for immediate requisitioning the record of Case No.50/2020/Food Safety, decided by Additional District Magistrate/Adjudicating Officer, Morena,
by the next date of hearing.
Siri S.S. Kushwaha, Government Advocate, is directed to communicate this order to Additional District Magistrate/Adjudicating Officer, Morena for submitting his personal explanation.
List this case on 18th of December, 2024.
